ideas.title: Following the Money: A Deep Dive into Federal Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the current federal investigations, including the Renee Good shooting investigation and the Trump assassination attempt investigation, and follow the money to see if there are any connections between them.
questions: What are the current federal investigations?
What are the implications for national security?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of corruption or wrongdoing at the national level. By following the money and investigating the connections between the current federal investigations, we may be able to shed light on a larger conspiracy.

ideas.title: The Wage Theft Epidemic: An Examination of Construction Firms
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of wage theft by construction firms and examine the larger pattern of exploitation of workers in the construction industry.
questions: What are the recent cases of wage theft by construction firms?
What are the implications for workers in the construction industry?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to shed light on a larger pattern of exploitation of workers in the construction industry. By examining the recent cases of wage theft and analyzing the data, we may be able to identify a larger epidemic and bring attention to the issue.
